purpose: Enumerates every founder-locked doctrine that the HQ Security Agent (ADR-0316a) enforces at code-inspection time. Each doctrine carries: identity · source ADR · check type · concrete forbidden patterns · rejection code under the sec.* namespace.
constitutional_rule: Every proposed code change MUST be checked against every doctrine below. Violation of any locked doctrine = HQ Security Agent REJECT. Doctrines are additive · never subtractive · founder-authored amendment ADR required to modify or remove any doctrine here.
amendment_path: Adding a new doctrine requires a founder-authored ADR referencing this registry. Removing or relaxing an existing doctrine requires an amendment ADR with explicit provenance footer + version tag (per D-17 amendment pattern locked in ADR-0314a.2.m).

doctrines.name: §7.3-B1 five-axis architecture
doctrines.principle: LAM Object Type ≠ Domain ≠ Category ≠ Operational Scope ≠ Agent/Runtime Identity. No axis may be substituted for another.
forbidden_patterns: Code that treats 'accommodation' (Domain) as if it were a Category value
Code that treats 'master_ai' (Operational Scope) as if it were a Domain
Any classifier that collapses two axes into one field without explicit five-axis expansion

doctrines.name: §7.6.5 G4 · Activity ≠ Domain
doctrines.principle: Activity concepts (rental · booking · subscription · delivery · service-request · ownership-transfer) are cross-Domain classifications applied to assets whose Domains remain authoritative. Never create *-Brain from an activity.
forbidden_patterns: New Domain named after an activity (rental_brain · booking_brain · delivery_brain)
Executor that routes activity slugs to a new Domain rather than applicable_domains registry
Classifier code that promotes 'rental' to a Domain axis value

doctrines.name: §7.7 H1 · `other` ≠ `unknown`
doctrines.principle: `other` = classified into governed bounded catch-all Category. `unknown` = classification unresolved. Silent conversion between the two is forbidden. UNKNOWN never silently becomes FALSE · never silently becomes very_low · never silently becomes contradiction.
forbidden_patterns: if (score == null) return 'very_low' — must return 'unknown'
if (missingEvidence) return 'FALSE' — must return 'UNKNOWN'
Silent conversion of null to zero or other proxy
Reason strings for UNKNOWN/FAIL that are null or non-canonical (not in CANONICAL_FAIL_CLOSED_REASONS)

doctrines.name: §7.8 J1 · physical ≠ logical authority
doctrines.principle: Physical location (Supabase · nex_dev) does not determine logical authority. The knowledge-extractor.ts §7.8 J1 double-NEX bug is a violation of this doctrine.
forbidden_patterns: Code assuming Supabase-hosted rows are less authoritative than nex_dev-hosted rows
Code with the 'NEX NEX' or 'nex.nex_' double-namespace anti-pattern

doctrines.name: §7.9 L1 · Business ≠ Services
doctrines.principle: Business is classifier tier + Lab. Services is brain-vertical tier + service_business substrate. Never conflated.
forbidden_patterns: Code that stores service_business rows in business_lead_directory or vice versa
Classifier that routes 'business' as if it were a specialist Services sub-Category

doctrines.name: §7.10 M1 · Domain axis closed at 9
doctrines.principle: The nine canonical Domains (accommodation · food · transport · business · travel · attractions · code · commerce · services) are locked. No new Domain may be created without founder-authored amendment ADR.
forbidden_patterns: New Domain enum value added anywhere in code
Classifier that emits a 10th Domain
Table that stores a Domain not in the canonical 9

doctrines.name: R-DOMAIN-01 · Anti-Substitution
doctrines.principle: The three-axis anti-substitution rule (LAM Object Type ≠ Domain ≠ Category) is enforced at every axis boundary. Silent substitution between axes is a G-2 non-bypass violation.
forbidden_patterns: Any code path where an axis value is assigned to a different axis without explicit reclassification

doctrines.name: R-10 gate-model doctrine
doctrines.principle: R-10 authorisation is the only path to AUTHORITATIVE. Not TE-Guardian ACCEPT. Not Truth Engine PASS. Only R-10.
forbidden_patterns: Code that writes AUTHORITATIVE without an authorisation_policy_ref field being set
Code that promotes a Claim to AUTHORITATIVE outside the R-10 code path
Silent shim that routes new rows to specialist tables bypassing Truth Engine + R-10

doctrines.name: ADR-0314f · Guardian responsibility split (four-way with ADR-0316a)
doctrines.principle: Lab-Guardian (data) · TE-Guardian (verdicts) · R-10 (authorisation) · HQ Security Agent (code). No rule may live in two Guardian tiers. Rejection codes namespaced with lab. / te. / r10. / sec. prefixes.
forbidden_patterns: Lab-Guardian code that enforces constitutional truth
TE-Guardian code that decides candidate acceptance
R-10 code that decides truth
Security Agent code that decides truth · candidate acceptance · or authorisation
Rejection code emitted from wrong namespace (e.g. Lab-Guardian emitting te.* code)

doctrines.name: ADR-0314i §9 · Anti-competing-substrate invariant
doctrines.principle: There is ONE canonical Knowledge substrate. Claim + Evidence + verifier_verdict + verification_state are PIPELINE substrates · never canonical Knowledge · never queried by the Router as truth.
forbidden_patterns: Router code that queries nex.claim or nex.evidence or nex.verifier_verdict as if they were knowledge
Any code that stores Claim rows alongside Knowledge rows in the same table without an authoritative marker
Code that lets pipeline substrates escape their PIPELINE label

doctrines.name: Observation ≠ Constitutional Authority
doctrines.principle: Observed data can tell NEX what IS happening. It cannot tell NEX what the constitutional policy SHOULD BE.
forbidden_patterns: Code that autonomously modifies a threshold based on runtime observations
Code that computes a 'best' threshold from observed data and applies it silently
Statistical curve-fitting that updates constitutional values without an ADR

doctrines.name: Calendar time ≠ Constitutional Authority
doctrines.principle: Rollout stages advance on founder-approved acceptance criteria + explicit founder gate. NEVER on 'N days elapsed'. Absence-of-problems ≠ presence-of-acceptance.
forbidden_patterns: Setter or scheduler that auto-advances a stage after N days
Timer-based auto-promotion
Code that treats absence of failure as authorisation to advance

doctrines.name: Thresholds are founder policy
doctrines.principle: Every threshold (R-01 min/max · R-11 band boundary · R-17 versioning % · R-20 tolerance · authority scores) is founder-authored. Master AI may recommend · never autonomously amend.
forbidden_patterns: Hardcoded threshold literals in rule modules (must consult versioned config)
Threshold values that don't carry 'Founder-authored threshold' provenance
Any code that computes a threshold from runtime data and writes it back

doctrines.name: No crawler zoo
doctrines.principle: NEX must NOT become a zoo of per-domain crawlers (hotel · food · transport · dentist · etc.). Target = general-purpose Acquisition Fabric where new domains are configuration + source-adapters + extraction policies.
forbidden_patterns: New file src/lib/nex/agent-runtime/worker-<newdomain>.ts for a Domain that isn't in the canonical 9
Per-Domain crawler script (nex-lab-<newdomain>-harvester.mjs) when a shared source-adapter already exists
New Lab room for what should be Layer B4 source-adapter configuration

doctrines.name: Knowledge-gap-driven acquisition
doctrines.principle: NEX asks 'what does NEX lack + which sources close the gap?' NOT 'what URLs can I scrape?' Autonomous acquisition loop is gap-driven · sources have machine-readable characteristics · change detection first-class · source disappearance NEVER cascades into knowledge deletion.
forbidden_patterns: Crawler that operates without consulting a knowledge-gap registry
Fixed-cadence re-crawl code without change-detection first
Code that deletes verified knowledge when its source disappears

doctrines.name: Entity Resolution + Location = first-class shared infrastructure
doctrines.principle: Neither a per-domain feature nor an English-Brain feature. Core NEX infrastructure. One shared service per axis.
forbidden_patterns: Per-domain Entity Resolution module (accommodation-entity-resolver.ts · food-entity-resolver.ts)
Row-metadata-only location handling when a full precision hierarchy is needed
Location logic reimplemented inside English Brain instead of consumed from shared service

doctrines.name: Do-not-repeat register (from Work Map)
doctrines.principle: Master AI must not re-audit any investigation in the do-not-repeat register without a specifically identified unresolved question.
forbidden_patterns: New audit ADR that duplicates an AUD-XXX already flagged do_not_repeat: true

doctrines.name: R-01 · plausibility thresholds locked
doctrines.principle: 14 founder-authored plausibility thresholds locked in ADR-0314a.2.n. Master AI may not add · remove · or modify.
forbidden_patterns: Changes to R01_THRESHOLDS constant in src/lib/nex/truth-engine/verifier/rules/r-01-plausibility.ts without founder amendment ADR
New attributes added to R-01 thresholds without founder authoring

doctrines.name: R-11 · 6-band confidence + unknown sentinel locked
doctrines.principle: The 6-band table (very_high 99-100 · high 95-98 · good 85-94 · moderate 70-84 · low 50-69 · very_low 0-49 · unknown null) is founder-authored. Unknown never silently converted to very_low.
forbidden_patterns: Changes to R11_BANDS constant without founder amendment ADR
New band boundary values in code
unknown-to-very_low silent conversion

doctrines.name: R-13 · 8-value relationship vocabulary baseline locked
doctrines.principle: The 8 baseline relationship kinds (synonym · antonym · hypernym · hyponym · related · domain_of · derived_from · part_of) are founder-ratified. Extensions require founder-authored extension ADR.
forbidden_patterns: Changes to R13_BASELINE constant without founder amendment ADR
New relation_kind value used in code without registry extension

doctrines.name: R-17 · 30% Levenshtein initial threshold locked
doctrines.principle: The 30% Levenshtein threshold + 6 versioning triggers are founder-authored (D-17). Master AI cannot tune based on observed change rates.
forbidden_patterns: Changes to LEVENSHTEIN_INITIAL_THRESHOLD constant
New versioning trigger added to shouldVersion() without founder amendment ADR

doctrines.name: R-18 envelope shape locked
doctrines.principle: Every verdict envelope must carry verifier_instance_id · rule_set_version · guardian_version · object_snapshot_ref · authorisation_policy_ref (null at Stage 1a) · truth_engine_ok · per_rule_verdicts. R-18 is envelope-audit only · never a promotion mechanism.
forbidden_patterns: VerdictEnvelope shape change without founder amendment ADR
Code that treats R-18 PASS as promotion signal

doctrines.name: R-20 · contradiction forbidden bases
doctrines.principle: Wording difference · scope difference · missing information · difference alone · unknown never automatically become CONTRADICTION_RECORDED. Only founder-authored per-attribute rules can promote a delta to contradiction.
forbidden_patterns: Code that emits CONTRADICTION_RECORDED for wording or scope differences
R-20 rule that promotes UNKNOWN to CONTRADICTION_RECORDED

doctrines.name: Stage 1b R-10-absent safety boundary
doctrines.principle: At Stage 1b, no Claim reaches AUTHORITATIVE via the constitutional pipeline. authorisation_policy_ref must remain NULL on all Stage 1b verdicts and state rows.
forbidden_patterns: Code that writes non-null authorisation_policy_ref at Stage 1b
Code that transitions claim_verification_state.current_state to AUTHORITATIVE at Stage 1b
Any legacy executor code that writes to specialist tables during Stage 1b (C-β freeze)

doctrines.name: Stage 1b · Lab-Guardian before production candidates (D-1b-2)
doctrines.principle: Sub-step 1b.3 (Lab-Guardian implementation) must complete + be founder-approved before 1b.4 (production adapter) commences.
forbidden_patterns: Production adapter code shipped before Lab-Guardian class exists
No-op Lab-Guardian placeholder in production adapter

doctrines.name: Stage 1b · rejection-active starts narrow (D-1b-4)
doctrines.principle: Rejection-active mode applies ONLY to explicitly-adapted production write paths. Wholesale activation across all Domains is forbidden.
forbidden_patterns: Code that toggles rejection-active on multiple Domains simultaneously without per-Domain founder authorisation

doctrines.name: Stage 1b · production determinism failure stops path (D-1b-7)
doctrines.principle: Determinism canary failure STOPS the relevant constitutional path. No silent auto-recovery.
forbidden_patterns: Retry-until-passes loop for determinism canaries
Silent handler that treats intermittent divergence as 'flakiness'
Auto-recovery code that resumes a path after determinism failure without founder gate

doctrines.name: Guardian public surface anti-invention
doctrines.principle: Guardian classes (Lab-Guardian · TE-Guardian · HQ Security Agent) must not expose methods with prefixes set*, update*, create*, promote*, authoris*, register*, install*, invent*, mutate*, persist*, apply*. Only inspect/read methods.
forbidden_patterns: Guardian class adds a method starting with set/update/create/promote/authoris/register/install/invent/mutate/persist/apply

doctrines.name: ADR-0022 · no third-party image copy on merchant import
doctrines.principle: Free listings import ONLY business text. Never copy logos · gallery · covers · products · video from Google Business Profile · Facebook · Instagram · any third party at any tier.
forbidden_patterns: Crawler code that fetches image URLs from Google Business Profile / Instagram / Facebook and stores them
Any code that copies third-party media into NEX storage

doctrines.name: ADR-0023 · seed listing rules
doctrines.principle: Seed listings store text only per the ADR field list · never invent data · never create login credentials · never mark verified. Every record starts status=listed · claimed=false · verified=false · visibility=public.
forbidden_patterns: Seed import that marks new listings verified=true
Seed import that creates login credentials
Directory crawler that fabricates fields not in the ADR-0023 approved list

doctrines.name: ADR-0024 · image manifest
doctrines.principle: Every image added to NEX MUST be recorded in data/nex-image-manifest.json at creation time. No image URL lands anywhere without a manifest row.
forbidden_patterns: Hardcoded image URL in component code (must read from manifest by tag)
Image upload endpoint that doesn't write a manifest row

doctrines.name: ADR-0025 · tiered image matcher thresholds
doctrines.principle: Never a single global threshold. Per-surface confident floors: directory cards 0.65 · brain chat 0.80 · marketing hero 0.90 · banner recs 0.75 · workshop diagrams 0.85 · search grid 0.60. Three-band response (Confident · Soft-caveat · Clarify).
forbidden_patterns: Image matcher code using a single global threshold
Confident response emitted below the per-surface floor

doctrines.name: UI theme · CLAUDE.md rules
doctrines.principle: Theme rules the Security Agent enforces on every UI-touching change.
forbidden_patterns: Em dashes in hero copy
AI-star or Sparkles icons anywhere (star icons in review chips are fine)
object-cover on non-hero images (default must be object-contain)
Text below 13px in donut app / dashboards · below 12px WCAG floor elsewhere
Yellow CTA outside the packages page (dark green #166534 elsewhere)
In-stock indicator green #10B981 used for CTAs (reserved colour)
Fabricated stats or metrics without evidence chain
Emojis outside explicit user request

doctrines.name: Founder-only destructive git operations
doctrines.principle: Never run destructive git operations (push --force · reset --hard · checkout . · restore . · clean -f · branch -D) unless founder explicitly requests.
forbidden_patterns: Automation script that runs git push --force
Automation script that runs git reset --hard
Automation script that skips hooks (--no-verify)

doctrines.name: Never modify Stage 1a foundation
doctrines.principle: src/lib/nex/truth-engine/verifier/* · src/lib/nex/truth-engine/verifier/rules/* · src/lib/nex/truth-engine/guardian/* · src/lib/nex/truth-engine/runner/* · db/migrations/stage-1a-* are the constitutional foundation. Modifications require founder-authored amendment ADR.
forbidden_patterns: Change to any Stage 1a file without a founder amendment ADR cited in commit message
Deletion of any Stage 1a test file

doctrines.name: Never bypass Work Map
doctrines.principle: docs/nex-work-map.json is the source of truth for capability identity. Every code change must be attributable to a CAP-XXX in the Work Map · or introduce one via ADR-authored amendment.
forbidden_patterns: Code change touching a file not owned by a CAP-XXX (per file-capability-map.json)
Change to Work Map JSON without an ADR authored

check_type_meanings.code_pattern: Static analysis of proposed code changes · regex or syntactic pattern matching · AST inspection where needed. Fast · deterministic · runs on every proposed change.
check_type_meanings.migration_check: Analysis of proposed SQL migrations for schema safety · substrate isolation · CHECK constraint preservation.
check_type_meanings.runtime_check: Requires running the code to observe behaviour. Reserved for cases where static analysis is insufficient. Rare · founder-authorised only.

priority_meanings.high: Load-bearing constitutional rule. Any violation blocks the code change absolutely.
priority_meanings.medium: Important but with founder-override escape hatch · founder must approve override explicitly.
priority_meanings.low: Style / hygiene rule. Warning surfaced but does not block.

notes_for_maintainers: This registry consolidates the Security Agent's rule surface. Adding new doctrines requires an ADR referencing this file.
Each doctrine has ONE rejection code (sec.<name>) so audit trails are unambiguous.
Doctrines never merge · never split without an ADR trail.
The Security Agent MUST enforce every doctrine at every inspection · no cherry-picking.
When a new locked doctrine is added (via new feedback memory · new ADR clause), a corresponding entry MUST be added here in the same PR.
